    "reason": "All sources consistently identify the subject as the Forbidden City (Zi Jin Cheng) corner tower ('Jiao Lou'), located at each of the four城墙 corners, with unanimous architectural description: triple-eaved composite roof system, cruciform plan with projecting bays (bao sha), stone platform (xumi zuo), white marble railings, dougong brackets, latticed windows (san jiao liu wan ling hua), and yellow glazed tile roofing. No ambiguity in building identity, location, or typological function."
  },
  "generation_module": "exterior_architecture",
  "scene_goal": "Generate a photorealistic exterior architectural visualization of the Forbidden City corner tower, emphasizing accurate volumetric composition, layered roof hierarchy, structural rhythm of eaves and dougong, material authenticity of glazed tile and painted wood, and precise articulation of base, railing, window, and cornice details — all conforming to Ming-dynasty imperial architectural conventions.",
  "spaces": [
    {
      "name": "corner tower exterior volume",
      "type": "exterior",
      "confidence": "confirmed"
    }
  ],
  "space_contracts": [
    {
      "space": "corner tower exterior volume",
      "boundary_mode": "closed",
      "floor": false,
      "walls": ["vertical wall surfaces including column grid, bracket sets, and painted timber framing"],
      "ceiling": false,
      "openings": ["triple-tiered roof eaves", "latticed sash windows (san jiao liu wan ling hua)", "door openings with threshold and lintel"],
      "connections": [],
      "vertical_geometry": ["three-tiered roof stack: uppermost cross-shaped double-hipped roof, middle tier with four projecting double-eaved bays, lower tier with continuous half-pitch waist eave"],
      "content_after_envelope": []
    }
  ],
  "envelope_model": "assembled_elements_with_verified_joints",
  "hard_finish": {
    "required": ["floor_finish", "wall_finish", "ceiling_finish", "skirting_or_baseboard", "door_window_frame_finish", "threshold_or_sill", "readable_room_light"],
    "conditional": [],
    "exclude_by_default": ["furniture", "decorative_props", "unverified_equipment"]
  },
  "adjacency_graph": [],
  "relationships": ["roof layers interlock structurally via shared ridge lines and intersecting hip/valley joints", "dougong clusters articulate load transfer from eave projection to column heads", "white marble railing wraps continuous perimeter of stone platform (xumi zuo), visually anchoring tower to base", "window latticework follows strict san jiao liu wan pattern, consistent across all four façades"],
  "spatial_envelope": {
    "mode": "closed",
    "footprint": "irregular cruciform (cross-shaped with asymmetric bays: two larger inner bays depth ~4m, two smaller outer bays depth ~1.6m)",
    "boundary_segments": ["floor", "wall", "roof"],
    "openings": ["window", "door"],
    "vertical_connections": []
  },
  "visual_language": {
    "style": "Ming dynasty imperial Chinese architecture",
    "materials": ["yellow glazed ceramic roof tiles", "painted timber (red lacquer columns, green-blue dragon-and-cloud polychrome on beams)", "white marble platform and railings", "dark brown timber dougong and bracket arms"],
    "lighting": "midday natural light with strong directional sun casting crisp shadows on layered eaves and railing balusters",
    "mood": "solemn, majestic, intricately ordered, historically grounded"
  },
  "must_have": ["28 wing angles across three roof tiers", "72 ridges total (including main, hip, valley, and corner ridges)", "copper-gilt finial (bao ding) at central roof intersection", "single-ascending-double-arching seven-step dougong on upper eave", "five-step dougong on middle eave", "five-step dougong on lower waist eave", "white marble balustrade with lotus-patterned posts and rail caps", "three-tiered roof silhouette with pronounced upward curvature (fei yao) on all wing tips"],
  "quality_gates": ["roof tile rows must follow authentic staggered coursing with correct overhang ratio (~1/3 tile length)", "dougong bracket arms must align precisely with column centerlines and eave projection limits", "window latticework must render exact 3×6 lozenge pattern with beveled muntins", "stone platform must show clear xumi zuo profile: upper and lower moldings, waistband, and base plinth"],
  "delivery_views": ["frontal 3/4 view showing two adjacent façades and full roof complexity", "elevation view aligned to cardinal axis", "low-angle ground-level view emphasizing platform and railing scale"],
  "prompt_directives": ["use physically-based rendering for glazed tile specular highlights and wet-look patina on marble", "prioritize geometric accuracy over artistic stylization — no simplification of roof intersections or dougong layering", "reference historical color palette: vermilion columns, lapis-and-malachite beam undersides, gold leaf on finials and bracket centers"],
  "hard_constraints": ["no interior spaces visible", "no human figures or modern elements", "no speculative reconstruction — only features documented in primary sources", "height ratio from platform base to finial must be ~27.5m (relative scaling acceptable if absolute units omitted)"],
  "soft_constraints": ["subtle atmospheric haze to suggest Beijing air quality", "soft shadow falloff on marble surface to imply early autumn light", "minor weathering on tile edges and timber paint to suggest age without decay"],
  "uncertainties": ["exact glaze hue variation across tile batches (source describes 'yellow' but not chromatic specification)", "precise curvature radius of wing-tip upturn (described as 'elegant lift' but no metric)", "exact number and placement of吻兽 (roof ridge ornaments) per ridge segment — sources cite totals (230–234) but not distribution logic"],
  "sources": [
    {
      "title": "角楼",
      "url": "https://www.dpm.org.cn/explore/building/236522.html",
      "channel": "agent_reach_exa",
      "reason": "Primary architectural documentation: confirms plan dimensions (8.73m square core, asymmetric bay depths), height (27.50m), roof composition (three-tiered歇山 + 抱厦), dougong specs (seven-/five-/five-step), railing presence, and material (yellow glazed tile, painted timber)."
    },
    {
      "title": "故宫角楼的建筑智慧-新华网",
      "url": "http://www.news.cn/politics/2021-09/11/c_1127850486.htm",
      "channel": "agent_reach_exa",
      "reason": "Confirms structural logic: '1 three-tiered pavilion + 4 double-eaved roofs + 2 single-eaved roofs', validates functional context (defensive lookout), and reinforces visual traits (28 wing angles, layered silhouette)."
    },
    {
      "title": "紫禁城角楼的传说_四九城_首都之窗_北京市人民政府门户网站",
      "url": "https://www.beijing.gov.cn/renwen/jrbj/sjc/201703/t20170303_1874495.html",
      "channel": "agent_reach_exa",
      "reason": "Provides verified plan geometry ('ten' character cross shape), wing angle count (28),窝角 count (16), and construction method (mortise-and-tenon, no iron nails)."
    },
    {
      "title": "故宫角楼琉璃瓦件样式研究",
      "url": "http://www.sanyamuseum.com/a/3/2022/0824/1178.html",
      "channel": "agent_reach_exa",
      "reason": "Specifies tile hierarchy: upper-tier wens use 'five-grade' size, mid-tier 'six-grade', lower-tier 'seven-grade'; confirms small-scale components due to compact footprint."
    }
  ]
}
